Release 2.2-6: prioritize native background tasks and add run records
Use finite UIKit tasks before audio, with one cancellable adaptive check and
safe task rotation. Start audio below 8 seconds; return to a valid task after
at least 5 seconds of audio and two spaced checks with 12 seconds of finite
budget. Preserve audio ownership, host calls, recordings and expiration guards.

Allow AI background work during valid task execution as well as owned audio.
Show the latest background entry, actual check, foreground return, stop reason
and monotonic check-to-return interval without timestamp-only refresh broadcasts.

Include the 2.2-4 through 2.2-6 audits, packages, symbols and SHA256 manifests.
Validation: 1,378 checks for the final adjustment, arm64/arm64e Rootless and
Rootful builds, package metadata and matching dSYM UUIDs; no new build warnings.

conclusion: The source restoration behavior added in 2.1-25 was removed when 2.2-1 reset to the 2.1-20 implementation. The frozen native 2.2-6, 2.2-7 and 2.2-8 sources all contain forced-top behavior. This establishes source lineage, not the first installed device package that exhibited the user-reported regression.
isolation: Read-only Git and historical frozen source/manifest reads; writes only the new scroll-position audit review directory. No package changes, installation, device, live account or database access.
